wok.context: A round-bottomed wok in side view with a long handle and a small loop handle. Use it for stir fry recipes, Asian cooking, woks in shop listings and fast high-heat cooking.

karahi.context: A deep round karahi pan with a loop handle on each side and no long handle. Use it for Indian and Pakistani curries, balti dishes and deep frying.

grill-pan.context: A square grill pan from above with raised ridges and a long handle. Use it for stovetop grilling, grill marks on steak or vegetables, and griddle pan listings.

griddle-plate.context: A flat rectangular griddle plate from above with a low rim and a handle at each end. Use it for pancakes, flat top cooking, planchas and hot plate recipes.

crepe-pan.context: A very flat crepe pan seen from above with a thin crepe inside and a long handle. Use it for crepes, galettes, thin pancakes and breakfast recipes.

paella-pan.context: A wide shallow paella pan from above with two loop handles, rice and a lemon wedge. Use it for paella, Spanish food, rice dishes and party cooking.

double-boiler.context: A bowl nested on top of a pot of simmering water. Use it for melting chocolate, making custards and sauces gently, and bain marie cooking.

bamboo-steamer.context: A round bamboo steamer in side view with two stacked tiers and a lid. Use it for dim sum, dumplings, buns and steamed vegetables.

tagine.context: A tagine: a shallow round dish under a tall conical lid with a small knob. Use it for Moroccan and North African stews and slow cooked dishes.

clay-pot.context: A round earthenware pot with a short neck, a small lid and ear handles. Use it for clay pot rice, stews, donabe cooking and traditional recipes.

casserole-dish.context: A deep casserole dish with a domed lid, a knob and small side handles. Use it for casseroles, stews, braises and oven cooking.

braiser.context: A wide shallow braiser with a low domed lid and two loop handles. Use it for braising, searing then simmering, and one-pan dinners.

baking-dish.context: An open rectangular baking dish with sloped sides and rim handles. Use it for lasagna, bakes, gratins, crumbles and oven recipes.

roasting-pan.context: A roasting pan with side handles holding a roast. Use it for roast dinners, turkey, roast chicken, Sunday roasts and oven roasting.

milk-pan.context: A small deep saucepan with a pouring spout pinched into the rim and a long handle. Use it for heating milk, sauces and small portions.

takoyaki-pan.context: A takoyaki pan from above with a grid of round wells and a short handle. Use it for takoyaki, aebleskiver, poffertjes and other round snacks.

pasta-pot.context: A tall pot with a perforated strainer insert lifted above the rim. Use it for boiling and draining pasta, stock pots and pasta cookers.

egg-poacher.context: An egg poacher pan from above with four cups, each holding a yolk, and a handle. Use it for poached eggs, breakfast menus and brunch recipes.

fish-poacher.context: A long oval fish poacher from above with a whole fish inside and handles at the ends. Use it for poaching whole salmon or other fish.

tawa.context: A flat round tawa griddle seen at an angle with a short handle. Use it for roti, chapati, paratha, dosa and other flatbreads.

couscoussier.context: A two-tier couscoussier: a perforated steamer sitting on a round-bellied pot. Use it for steaming couscous over stew and North African cooking.

pot-lid.context: A round pot lid with a centre knob seen at a slight angle. Use it for lids, covering pans, simmering and cookware parts.

divided-hot-pot.context: A round hot pot from above split into two broths by a curved divider, with two side handles. Use it for hot pot restaurants, shabu shabu and shared meals.

fish-grill-basket.context: A hinged fish-shaped wire basket with a grid and a long handle. Use it for grilling whole fish, barbecues and outdoor cooking.

egg-ring.context: A round egg ring with a folding handle and an egg cooking inside. Use it for perfectly round fried eggs, breakfast muffins and brunch.

idli-stand.context: An idli stand: stacked round plates with dimples joined by a centre rod with a top handle. Use it for idli, South Indian breakfast and steamed rice cakes.

ramekin.context: A small round ramekin dish with ribbed sides. Use it for souffles, creme brulee, baked custards, dips and single servings.

pizza-peel.context: A pizza peel: a wide flat paddle on a long handle. Use it for pizza ovens, bread baking, homemade pizza and pizzerias.

pizza-cutter.context: A pizza cutter: a round blade wheel on a handle with a finger guard. Use it for slicing pizza, pastry and flatbreads.

oven-mitt.context: A quilted oven mitt with a thumb, a cuff and a hanging loop. Use it for handling hot pans and trays, baking and heat protection.

pot-holder.context: A square quilted pot holder with a hanging loop at one corner. Use it for handling hot pots, kitchen textiles and heat protection.

measuring-cup.context: A measuring jug with graduation marks, a pouring spout and a handle. Use it for measuring liquids, recipe amounts and baking.

measuring-spoons.context: A set of three measuring spoons of different sizes joined on a ring. Use it for recipe measurements, baking and teaspoon or tablespoon amounts.

mixing-bowl.context: A wide mixing bowl with a thick rim and a small pouring lip, in side view. Use it for mixing batter and dough, prep work and baking recipes.

egg-separator.context: An egg separator cup holding a yolk while the white drips through below. Use it for separating eggs for meringue, custard and baking.

whisk.context: A balloon whisk with wire loops on a straight handle. Use it for whisking eggs, whipping cream, mixing batter and baking.

egg-beater.context: A rotary egg beater with a top grip, a crank wheel and two beaters. Use it for hand mixing, whipping cream, beating eggs and vintage kitchens.

dough-docker.context: A dough docker: a spiked roller on a frame with a handle. Use it for pricking pastry, pie crusts, pizza bases and crackers before baking.

food-cloche.context: A serving cloche: a dome cover with a knob resting on a plate. Use it for room service, restaurant menus, meal serving and catering.

aluminum-foil.context: A box of aluminium foil with a crinkled sheet pulled out below. Use it for wrapping food, baking, grilling and kitchen supplies.

popsicle-mold.context: An ice pop mold tray holding three pops, each with a stick. Use it for homemade ice pops, frozen treats and summer recipes.

spatula.context: A kitchen turner with a slotted flat blade on a long handle. Use it for flipping pancakes, burgers and eggs, and frying.

slotted-spoon.context: A long-handled spoon with slot holes in the bowl. Use it for lifting food out of liquid, draining and serving.

ladle.context: A ladle with a deep round bowl and a long handle ending in a hook. Use it for serving soup, stew, sauces and punch.

kitchen-tongs.context: Kitchen tongs: two arms joined by a spring loop with scalloped gripping ends. Use them for grilling, turning food, serving salad and barbecues.

spider-strainer.context: A spider strainer: a flat round wire web on a long handle. Use it for lifting fried food, noodles and dumplings out of hot oil or water.

silicone-spatula.context: A silicone spatula with a flat blade, one corner rounded, on a long handle. Use it for scraping bowls, folding batter and baking.

wooden-spoon.context: A wooden spoon with an oval bowl and a long straight handle. Use it for stirring sauces, home cooking, baking and recipes.

pasta-server.context: A pasta server: a spoon with short teeth around the bowl and a hole in the middle. Use it for serving spaghetti and long pasta.

potato-masher.context: A potato masher with a wavy wire head and a straight handle. Use it for mashed potatoes, purees and mashing vegetables or beans.

garlic-press.context: A garlic press with two hinged handles and a perforated chamber, with crushed garlic falling out. Use it for crushing garlic and ginger in recipes.

rasp-grater.context: A long narrow rasp grater with fine teeth and a handle. Use it for zesting citrus, grating hard cheese, nutmeg, garlic and ginger.

box-grater.context: A four-sided box grater with a top handle and rows of holes. Use it for grating cheese, shredding vegetables and prep work.

vegetable-peeler.context: A Y-shaped vegetable peeler with a slotted blade across its arms. Use it for peeling potatoes, carrots, apples and prep work.

apple-slicer.context: An apple slicer: a ring with blades radiating from a centre corer and two handles. Use it for coring and cutting apples and pears into wedges.

salad-spinner.context: A salad spinner bowl with a lid, a pump knob on top and leaves inside. Use it for washing and drying lettuce, greens and herbs.

winged-corkscrew.context: A winged corkscrew with both levers raised, a top knob and a spiral worm. Use it for opening wine bottles, bars and wine lists.

kitchen-shears.context: Kitchen shears with straight blades, a serrated edge and thick loop handles. Use them for cutting herbs, poultry, packaging and food prep.

baster.context: A turkey baster: a long tube with a squeeze bulb at one end. Use it for basting roasts, turkey and chicken with their juices.

kitchen-funnel.context: A kitchen funnel with a wide cone, a narrow spout and a side ring tab. Use it for pouring liquids, filling bottles and jars, and canning.

meat-tenderizer.context: A meat tenderizer mallet with a spiked face on its head. Use it for pounding and tenderizing steak, schnitzel and chicken breast.

meat-thermometer.context: A meat thermometer: a round dial on a long pointed probe. Use it for checking roast, steak and grill temperatures and food safety.

molcajete.context: A stone mortar standing on three short legs with a stubby pestle. Use it for Mexican cooking, grinding spices and making salsa or guacamole.
